Name: Kenneth's Halloween Trick or Treat
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Trick or Treat, farmer![/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Spirit's Eve is tomorrow, so here's a little something for tonight. Every Fall 27, you'll get a spooky basket in the mail.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Nothing too OP, just some Halloween fun - jack-o-lanterns to decorate, pumpkins, candies (cakes & cookies), and some creepy stuff for the season. Plus a rare scarecrow.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What's inside:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]2x Jack-O-Lantern, 20x Pumpkin, 10x Chocolate Cake, 10x Cookies, 5x Pink Cake, 10x Bat Wing, 10x Void Essence, 1x Rarecrow, 2x Chest, 3x Golden Mystery Box, Stardrop Tea + 12k gold.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Details:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Arrives yearly Fall 27 via mail[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Yearly - comes back every year[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Balanced, lore-friendly, not cheaty[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- SDV 1.6+[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Super Lightweight - only Content Patcher, no extra dependencies, no performance impact[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- One version, just install and enjoy[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Happy Halloween![/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Compatibility: All of my yearly mail gift mods are on separate mod pages but they work perfectly together with no conflicts and no overwrites. You can install just one or all of them if you want to experience celebrations throughout the whole year - your choice! Full list:[/b][/size]
